{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
df["revenue"] = df["revenue"].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for QA orders: revenue == 999999.99 (after cleaning)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
num_qa = len(qa_orders)

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_orders = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Remove QA orders from completed orders for accurate mean
completed_no_qa = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders (excluding QA)
mean_revenue_completed_no_qa = completed_no_qa['revenue'].mean()

# Print the results
print(f'Number of QA orders: {num_qa}')
print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders (excluding QA): {mean_revenue_completed_no_qa}')
print(f'Number of completed orders (excluding QA): {len(completed_no_qa)}')"}
